name: Cascade 3
description: A cushioned trail running shoe with a grippy rubber outsole and a rock plate, built for long training runs on technical, rocky trails in hot, dry climates.

name: Pulse Racer
description: A carbon-plated racing shoe engineered for competitive 10K and half-marathon race day, with a propulsive foam midsole for experienced runners chasing a personal best.

description: A two-step ceramide-rich cleanser and moisturizer set formulated for dry, sensitive skin prone to redness, designed to restore the skin barrier in under three minutes each morning.

name: Glow Reset Serum
description: A vitamin C brightening serum for dull, uneven-toned combination skin, meant to be layered into a five-minute evening routine alongside a nightly moisturizer.

name: Loft 30
description: A HEPA air purifier built for larger living rooms and open-plan spaces up to 30 square meters, with an auto mode that ramps up when it senses cooking smoke or pet dander.

name: Nightstand Mini
description: A tiny HEPA air purifier sized for a nightstand or desk, made for light sleepers who want cleaner air in a small bedroom without any noticeable fan noise at night.
